subject: Advanced Project Management
text: An IT services company, has taken up a project to develop a cloud-based inventory tracking system for a medium-sized retail chain. The timeline is strict—delivery must be completed within six months. The project manager, Rohan, leads a team of 18 members from different technical and functional backgrounds. Early in the project Rohan faced several challenges: •   Client frequently updated requirements, causing confusion among developers. • Communication gaps among cross-functional teams led to rework. • Two senior developers resigned mid-project. • The client expected proactive status reporting and quick risk response. Rohan created a detailed communication plan, reskilled the junior team, ensured continuous requirement clarification meetings with the client, and re-prioritized project activities. He negotiated for additional temporary resources to meet timelines and improved morale through recognition programs. The project was completed successfully within the deadline, and the client was satisfied. Critically analyze the skills demonstrated by Rohan that contributed to the success of the project by identifying at least five essential Project Management skills required in this case and justify how each skill supported successful project execution.

subject: Advanced Project Management
text: Gamify Solutions manages multiple product development projects using traditional 5 project management practices. Team members often work on several tasks at the same time, leading to frequent switching and slow progress. Many engineers delay starting their work until deadlines come close, causing last-minute rush and quality issues. On the other hand, some tasks get stretched unnecessarily when additional time is available even though they could be finished earlier. These behaviors have resulted in missed deadlines, high rework, and customer dissatisfaction. Senior leadership is exploring Critical Chain Project Management (CCPM) as a possible improvement approach. Analyze the case and identify the challenges faced by Gamify Solutions, and explain how CCPM can help address these challenges.

subject: Advanced Project Management
text: Bright Pharma recently introduced a formal Project Management Methodology (PMM) to streamline new product development. However, several teams continued using their old informal practices. Project managers complained that documentation requirements were time-consuming, employees lacked PM training, and senior management rarely reviewed project progress. As a result, schedules slipped, communication gaps increased, and no consistent reporting was followed across departments. Analyze the case and identify four major barriers to effective implementation of PM methodologies at Bright Pharma. Provide brief justification for each.
